products.name: Reptune.net Platform
products.description: The Reptune.net subscription that every multinational buys first, sold in three plans that scale with the number of Local Files: Core (up to 25 Local Files), Advanced (up to 50) and Enterprise (50+). Every plan comes with unlimited users, the Automated Report Generator, the dashboard with worldmap, the TP Workflow, AI-assisted writing, the R-AI Onboarding Assistant, country regulations for 170+ countries, report styling in the corporate identity, data exchange and validation, and 2 expert hours per year. Advanced adds SSO, R-AI Country Expert, custom text and 4 hours; Enterprise adds custom user profiles, CbCR, divisions and 8 hours. Machine translation, CbCR, SSO, R-AI Country Expert, custom templates, custom transactional data models and custom development are add-ons. ISO 27001 certified, no installation, up and running in days after a free two-week trial.

products.name: Automated Report Generator
products.description: The rule-based generator that produces Master Files and Local Files for 170+ countries at the press of a button once company types, functional analyses, transfer pricing methods and benchmarks have been configured in the model. Built on an OECD-aligned template structure with best-practice standard templates, localised templates (for example Italy), custom templates and custom text, report styling in the client's corporate identity, draft or final output, built-in validation that flags gaps before generation, and automatic insertion of archived benchmarks, intercompany agreements and structure charts. Exported Word and PDF files need no manual changes, which is where the 50 to 75 percent time and cost savings come from.

products.name: Country-by-Country Reporting and EU Public CbCR
products.description: Country-by-Country Reporting on the same platform as the Master File and Local Files: CbCR data management with manual or bulk Excel entry per constituent entity, automated validation with an Actions Required page, filing-ready CbCR XML and Excel output, CbCR notifications with auto-calculated deadlines per country, and EU Public CbCR under Directive (EU) 2021/2101 generated in XHTML with inline XBRL from the existing CbCR data. Australian Public CbCR is coming. Included in the Enterprise plan and available as an OECD / EU public CbCR add-on on Core and Advanced; also used for Pillar Two transitional CbCR safe-harbour checks.
